note: Round two. Subject is matched inside each pair, and from this round the *camera* is matched too: every entry names the eye height, aim height, standoff and field of view its Rome II partner was measured at — see the `ab2-` block in tools/shoot.mjs. Round one's graders all three reported that our side was gameplay grabs from a high tactical camera against press captures at ground level, and that framing alone would have sorted the deck after four pairs. Rome II side is one of the twenty-two official store screenshots in reference/rome2-steam; see its SOURCES.md for the URL of each. Four of the twenty-two are campaign-map shots with the full interface up and are never eligible.
